summary: FTX is ADVERSE: as of 2026-10-01 it is in bankruptcy (Chapter 11 filed 2022-11-11) and faces major enforcement actions from the CFTC and SEC for fraud, while no criminal conviction has been recorded.

findings.statement: The exact legal name of FTX is FTX Trading Ltd.
FTX Trading Ltd was incorporated in Antigua and Barbuda, with its headquarters in The Bahamas.
FTX was founded by Sam Bankman‑Fried and Gary Wang.
As of 2026-10-01, FTX is undergoing bankruptcy proceedings, having filed a Chapter 11 petition on November 11, 2022.
As of 2026-10-01, the CFTC and SEC have brought enforcement actions against FTX for fraud and wrongdoing.
As of 2026-10-01, FTX has not been convicted of a criminal offense; only regulatory charges have been filed.

minor_adverse_items: CFTC under the Biden administration had leveled enforcement cases against FTX for fraud. (unrated; npr.org)
conflict_notes: Jurisdiction of incorporation: OFI LA.gov states FTX Trading Ltd is incorporated in Antigua and Barbuda, while a CFTC speech describes FTX as Bahamas‑based (suggesting headquarters or operational base). The incorporation claim is weighted more heavily (specific legal filing) and is treated as the decisive fact.
